hints.title: Triplet Conditions
hints.text: A triplet (i, j, k) with 0 <= i < j < k < n is good if |arr[i] - arr[j]| <= a, |arr[j] - arr[k]| <= b, and |arr[i] - arr[k]| <= c.

hints.title: Constraint Size
hints.text: Since n <= 300, a three-level nested loop takes at most 300^3 / 6 <= 4.5 * 10^6 iterations.

hints.title: Early Pruning
hints.text: Prune the innermost loop early if |arr[i] - arr[j]| > a.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Given N <= 300, the O(N^3) brute force with early pruning executes in well under 20 milliseconds.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant extra memory and straightforward iteration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks bounds and places early-pruning condition inside second loop.
complexity.notes: Can also be optimized to O(N^2) using a Fenwick tree.

solutions.approach: Triple nested loops with early pruning on second index
